newsitem.title: UK: Hendrix guitar could fetch $300,000 at auction.
newsitem.headline: Hendrix guitar could fetch $300,000 at auction.

text.p: A Fender Stratocaster guitar once owned by rock legend Jimi Hendrix is to be the star of a London auction where it could fetch more than 180,000 pounds ($300,000), auctioneers said on Thursday.

The mid-60's instrument was given by Hendrix to his New York neighbour Al Kooper, founder of the rock band Blood, Sweat and Tears who was also a regular session musician for Bob Dylan and the Rolling Stones.
"The appearance of this guitar on the market offers collectors a rare opportunity to acquire a genuinely owned and played Hendrix Stratocaster," said a Sotheby's spokesman of the September 17 sale.
In 1990, Sotheby's sold a 1968 Fender Stratocaster used by Hendrix at the Woodstock Festival for a world record price of 198,000 pounds.
